routes.acceptedDelta: The oracle froze the reference dist on 2026-07-17 with no operations data behind it, so the next-op card captured its "NO UPCOMING OPS" empty state. GET__dashboard.json and GET__me__deployments.json feed the card, which now names the scheduled operation and counts down to it. Fixture-fed, not a UI change.

The queue selects its first row when nothing is picked, and the review drawer reads that mission's own briefing. The React capture had no mission detail behind it; GET__missions__00000000-0000-4000-c000-000000000004.json supplies the submission the queue is anchored to, so the drawer renders the briefing beside the row.
The React capture recorded the empty audit list as a paragraph. GET__admin__audit-logs.json feeds ten entries, each an expandable row button.

The reference ContentManager pre-filled a hardcoded mock briefing ("Operation Blue Storm Briefing", published switch on), and the first Leptos accept recorded the manager starting empty because no /cms/announcements fixture existed. GET__cms__announcements.json now supplies the live-shaped list — four published rows and one draft, ordered pinned-first then most recently updated — so the manager renders its real populated state. React reference kept at content.react.dom.json.

The roster toolbar gained a Sync Roles action after the freeze and the sort control now names its key ("Sort: Name"), so the first two controls shift along and a third appears. The six roster rows come from GET__admin__users.json, where the React capture recorded a single placeholder row.
Server identities come from GET__servers.json — TBD Primary/Secondary/Staging. The React capture rendered its own "TBD Main Server" / "TBD Training Ground" mock, which no fixture has ever contained.
The React capture recorded the empty board as a paragraph. GET__announcements.json feeds four entries, each a selectable card.

Neither the leave-of-absence panel nor the LOA review queue existed when the React dist was frozen, so the golden contains neither section. The service record is fed by GET__me__deployments.json, committed 2026-07-26 — nine days after the freeze — and the two panels by the new GET__me__leave-requests.json and GET__admin__leave-requests.json.
The React capture recorded the empty schedule as a paragraph. GET__events.json feeds the operations list and the detail pane beside it.

The operation briefing gained a block and its summary line became a prose paragraph rather than a chip row, both after the freeze. The armoury rows below come from GET__events__c71a4d1a-a616-4b88-ba7a-fccbc5ca26b7.json, whose armoury was populated after the freeze.
The order of battle is fed by GET__event-missions__89b1b731-37a8-4926-901a-3c7ff7de5eb3__orbat.json; the React capture recorded the unfed paragraph in its place.
Ladder rows come from GET__leaderboards.json. The React capture rendered its own mock ladder ("Reaper", 5.92), which no fixture has ever contained.

The /missions scrollport drops backdrop-blur-xl because the per-frame re-blur caused scroll lag, and the glass tint moved to a static z-0 layer behind the composited scroller — that is the relative-to-absolute and children-count difference here. The catalogue itself is fed by GET__missions.json. React reference kept at missions.react.dom.json.

The mission header became a wrapping flex row after the freeze: the title moved into a block of its own and the trailing paragraph became an action button pushed to the far edge. The status chip is title-cased, "Draft" rather than "draft". The mission data behind it is unchanged.

GET__modpacks.json carries one modpack, Core Modern Expansion 2.1. The React capture rendered a three-entry 2.4.1 mock that no fixture has ever contained, which is why the Leptos capture is the smaller of the two.

The status stream is fixtured for the first time: GET__servers__00000000-0000-4000-d000-000000000001__status__stream.sse.txt is served as text/event-stream, so the panel's preferred source is a decoded frame rather than the empty object the router used to return for an unmatched API call. The rendered difference is the populated panel fed by GET__servers.json in place of the React capture's unfed paragraph; the frame reproduces that row's cached status by design, so both sources agree.

Service totals come from GET__me__deployments.json, committed 2026-07-26 — nine days after the 2026-07-17 freeze. The oracle's zeros are the unfed state, not a UI state; the fixture's 17 operations and 92.5 per cent attendance are what the page is given.

The calculator gained a Weapon select and an Operation select after the freeze, which is the pair of extra fields and the input grid moving from four columns to three, and the plot became a real SVG rather than positioned divs. Default firing-point coordinates changed with it.
Catalogue rows and faction labels come from GET__vehicle-database.json, which spells the faction "USSR". The React capture rendered its own "USSR Forces" mock.

GET__wiki.json carries four pages across two categories. The React capture rendered a four-category mock ("Leadership Fundamentals" and others) that no fixture has ever contained, which is why the Leptos capture is the smaller of the two.
Same page and same cause as the wiki route: the article view renders the corpus's two categories where the React capture rendered its own four-category mock.
